reviews.title: Great price for a graphics card
reviews.comment: Graphics cards are very pricey and being able to get a used one for half the price of a new one is really good especially with amazons refurbished tech return policy being very good. I have used this graphics card for about a month and a half of intense gaming for things like starfield, CS2, call of duty, etc and the picture quality is really good (at 1080p). The packaging was very good, although not the original box, was a very adequate sized box filled with a compressible foam on all sides and around the pins themselves, and an anti-static bag to top it off, very professional. It also came with all of the display port and hdmi port plugs which is nice to keep dust out and not have to worry about cleaning. Overall great quality for a second hand/refurbished GPU and it performs to all specs stated with no issue. My build for reference: amd ryzen 7 5800x B550 pro-wifi Corsair vengeance ddr4 3200 2x16
reviews.author: Kyle

reviews.title: Good gpu aslong as you get a warranty
reviews.comment: Paired this gpu with a 570x taichi mother board and ryzen 7 5800x3d. For 1080p gaming this card runs very well at 65 degrees Celsius max temp running Space marine 2 on ultra settings (which is a gpu and cpu burdening game) so good results. It’s as good as a brand new asus 3070 and bench marks similarly with new 3070’s. Make sure you get a warranty with the card can’t hurt right? Overall very happy with my purchase.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: perfect upgrade
reviews.comment: Works as intended, great option. Upgraded my grandpa (who is over 70 years old and still playing video games) from a gtx 1080 to this and he absolutely loves it and doesnt stop talking about how amazing everything looks and feels.

reviews.title: Good, Cost Effective Upgrade for an Older Computer
reviews.comment: I needed to upgrade my graphics card to handle the latest Lightroom Classic updates.  Not a cutting edge product now but very cost effective. It handles editing in Lightroom, DxO Mark, Topaz Photo AI and Portrait Pro without a problem.
